jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Junior Software Engineer**

**Location:** Kochi - Work from Office

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 2 - 4 Years

**Department:** Product Engineering

**Salary Range:** INR 35,000 - 40,000/-

**The Role**

As a Junior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for implementing end-to-end features, working alongside Tech Leads and Associate Engineers to translate architectural blueprints into production-ready code. You will play a crucial role in building out our Core Notification Engine, multi-tenant routing handlers, and product microservices.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Feature Delivery:** Develop robust, scalable microservices in Java/Spring Boot and dynamic, responsive UIs in Angular**.**

**Database Management:** Write database-agnostic code using Spring Data JPA/Hibernate and assist in creating portable schema migration scripts via Flyway/Liquibase.

**Micro-Frontend Integration:** Build independent Angular modules that plug seamlessly into our federated host shell, adhering to our central design system.

**Event-Driven Integration:** Implement notification adapters (Email, WebSockets/SSE) and publish/consume events via our central message broker.

**Code Review & Standards:** Write clean, maintainable code, actively participate in peer code reviews, and ensure high test coverage (Unit, Integration, and Contract testing).

**Agile Execution:** Collaborate closely with QA, DevOps, and Product Management to unblock features and deliver sprint commitments.

**Required Qualifications**

2 to 4 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer.

Proven commercial experience building backend services with Java and Spring Boot.

Hands-on experience developing Single Page Applications (SPAs) using Angular (TypeScript).

Solid understanding of relational database design and experience working with at least one major RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL Server).

Experience with RESTful API design, implementation, and security (JWT, OAuth2). Experience writing unit tests (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine/Karma).

**Nice-to-Haves**

Experience with cloud-native deployment tools (Docker, Docker Compose, basic Kubernetes).

Familiarity with Multi-Tenancy architectures or SaaS building blocks.

Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture (RabbitMQ, Kafka) or real-time web protocols (SSE/WebSockets).

Experience with Angular Module Federation or Micro-Frontend concepts. AI & Agentic

**Framework Exposure:**

Experience leveraging AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate delivery. Familiarity with or interest in Agentic AI frameworks (such as LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI) is a strong plus as we explore embedding autonomous, goal-directed AI workflows into our product suite.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in the similar field?
* This position is based in Kochi, Kerala. Are you willing to commute and/or relocate for the same ?
* Are you willing to accept the offered salary range?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat.  
**Qualification Required:** B.E./B.Tech only. Candidates from Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related technical branches preferred.  
**Experience:** 1 - 3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Reporting To:** CTO

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on **Full-Stack Software Engineer** to join BidVeda and help take our product from prototype to a production-ready B2B SaaS platform.

You will work directly with the CTO and take ownership of features across the **frontend, backend, APIs, database, cloud deployment and AI/LLM integrations**.  
This is an opportunity to work in an early-stage product environment where your technical decisions will directly shape the product and engineering practices.

**Key Skills**

* React / Next.js or similar frontend framework
* Node.js / Python or similar backend framework
* PostgreSQL / MySQL or similar database
* REST / GraphQL APIs
* AWS / GCP / Azure
* AI / LLM API integration
* Git and collaborative development
* Cloud deployment and CI/CD
* Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot

**Candidates who have built and deployed a complete product independently are preferred.**

**Please share your GitHub profile and links to live products/projects along with your resume.**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Generative AI Intern
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Generative AI Intern

**Location:** Mohali (On-site)  
**Duration:** 45 Days Internship

**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate and curious Generative AI Intern to join our team for a short-term, high-impact internship. This role is ideal for candidates who want hands-on industry exposure and practical experience in working with cutting-edge AI technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in developing and implementing Generative AI models and solutions
* Work on real-world AI use cases including text generation, chatbots, and automation
* Support data preparation, prompt engineering, and model testing
* Collaborate with the development team on AI-driven projects
* Document workflows, findings, and improvements

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, or related field
* Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and Python programming
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools (e.g., LLMs, APIs) is a plus
* Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn

**What You Will Gain**

* Practical industrial exposure in Generative AI applications
* Opportunity to work on live projects and real business problems
* Mentorship from experienced professionals
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion
* Experience Letter for your professional portfolio
* Potential full-time opportunity based on performance

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed or share their updated resume.

**Kickstart your career in Generative AI and gain real-world experience in just 45 days!**

Job Type: Internship

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: generative AI
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate and enthusiastic **Generative AI Intern** who is eager to explore cutting-edge AI technologies, build intelligent applications, and work on real-world projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Design and optimize prompts for various AI use cases.
* Work with OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or other Generative AI models.
* Build AI chatbots, assistants, and automation workflows.
* Integrate AI APIs into web and mobile applications.
* Assist in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) implementation.
* Collaborate with development teams to deliver AI-based client solutions.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in Generative AI technologies.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of Python programming.
* Knowledge of Generative AI concepts and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Familiarity with Prompt Engineering.
* Understanding of REST APIs and API integrations.
* Basic knowledge of Machine Learning fundamentals.
* Knowledge of LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases, or RAG is a plus
* Eagerness to learn and adapt to new AI technologies.

What You'll Gain

* Hands-on experience working on live client projects.
* Mentorship from experienced AI professionals.
* Exposure to modern AI frameworks and tools.
* Opportunity to build an industry-ready portfolio.
* Practical experience with Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, LLMs, and AI integrations.
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion.
* Outstanding performers may receive a **Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)** or full-time employment opportunity at Bexo.ai.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
